speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or the character of your abdominal pain recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: The duration of your symptoms aligns with systemic involvement. Regarding the abdominal pain, is it associated with any recent changes in appetite, or have you noticed any visible lumps or swelling in your abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma) presenting with B symptoms and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy.
